thread:
Morgan: PacificLift sent APAC routing quote for 72 H100s. Options: standard sea -> SGN (16-20w) or expedited air charter -> SIN (2-4w). Charter adds ~+31%/unit but avoids long AMS/SEA backhaul. They also offer a SIN depot RMA kit hold (24h swap) if we prepay and sign addendum. PO in drive.

Priya: Important: SIN depot can do rapid swap but customs there require importer registration and importer of record docs. We don't currently have the SIN importer license on file. That changes feasibility.

Sanjay: Cluster side  can we accept a 24-unit air tranche in ap-southeast-1 without hurting regional latency-sensitive workloads?

Mei (PacificLift): We can split 24 air / 48 sea. For air we can do a consolidated charter for the 24 to reduce per-unit uplift versus standard airfreight. SIN depot hold requires signed SLA + prepaid hold (~SGD 8k/mo) and deposit. We can pre-assign serial ranges to the manifest to speed intake.

Morgan: Planner ask: reserve a 4-node air canary to SIN to validate rack-to-network path and thermal profiles (regional cooling differences). Ops: can you run a thermal-burn plan?

Sanjay: Yes, can do a 4-node canary burn and perf test. Need AWB + serial CSV and importer docs. ETA for prep ~12 days after we have docs. Also need transient burst quota for Dedicated in ap-southeast-1 for 48-72h.

Priya: Finance check: full-air delta = ~+$210k. Split (24 air / 48 sea) ~+$85k + depot hold/registration costs. finance-bot, flag budget threshold for APAC top-ups.

finance-bot: Budget flag added: "APAC top-up > $100k requires Director approval".

Mei (PacificLift): We'll DM proforma AWB, manifest CSV, and a prepay quote for 30/60/90d depot hold tonight. Note: SIN customs sometimes request proof of thermal-compliant packaging for GPU pallets; we'll add that to the proforma.

ops-bot: Reminder added: "obtain importer license + attach thermal-pack cert + HS 8471 docs".

Morgan: PO snippet for context:
```
PO: PO-501209
qty: 72 H100
split-plan: 48 sea / 24 air (4-unit air canary to SIN)
ETA-air-canary: 2-4w
ETA-sea-bulk: 16-20w
RMA-depot: SIN, 20 kits hold, 24h swap SLA (requires SLA addendum + prepay)
notes: importer license required for SIN clearance, preassign serials, thermal packaging cert
```

Priya: Action items: 1) Mei send AWB + manifest + hold tiers (EOD) 2) Legal review SLA addendum re: depot swap liability 3) Ops schedule 4-node canary + request transient quota. :thumbsup:
